# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 26 Oct 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Home Prices & Sales — Q3 2026

- **Private home prices up 1.4% in Q3, fastest pace in nearly two years** - URA data released 23 October shows private home prices rose 1.4% quarter-on-quarter in Q3 2026, accelerating from 0.5% in Q2. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-private-home-prices-rise-1-4-in-q3-2026-amid-a-quieter-new-launch-calendar/)

- **Price gains came even as quarterly sales fell to their lowest point this year** - Private home sales dropped 16.3% to 5,146 units in Q3, with price gains attributed in part to projects such as Lentor Gardens Residences and higher land costs. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/private-home-prices-rose-fastest-pace/)

## HDB Resale Market — Q3 2026

- **HDB resale volumes hit a two-year high while prices slipped for a third straight quarter** - Transactions climbed to 7,645 flats in Q3 2026, the highest quarterly level since 2024, as resale prices dipped 0.1% and the market continued to stabilise. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-transactions-hit-a-two-year-high-in-q3-2026-as-prices-continue-to-decline/)

- **Record 596 million-dollar HDB flats changed hands in Q3 despite the overall price dip** - The number of HDB resale flats transacted at $1 million or above reached a quarterly record of 596 units, even as the broader resale price index edged lower. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-resale-prices-fell-last-quarter/)

## Rental Market & Commercial Property

- **Condo and HDB rental volumes fell for a second consecutive month in September** - Both condo and HDB leasing volumes declined again in September 2026, though rents remained above year-ago levels. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-rental-market-september-2026/)

- **Office rents rose 0.8% and retail rents 0.7% in Q3, with AI firms driving office demand** - Tech and AI sector expansion is supporting office leasing activity and tight supply, while the retail sector faces headwinds from major retailers cutting back. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/office-retail-positive-one-might-better/)
